fields.label: Περιγραφή
fields.before:
This backpack is perfect for your little one! Soft colors and playful flowers give the bag a cheerful, dreamy look, perfect for little adventurers discovering the world step by step.
 The backpack is water-repellent and practically organized with smart storage compartments, including a separate pocket for a cup. Thanks to the adjustable mesh shoulder straps and the handy chest buckle, the bag always stays comfortable and securely in place. Extra fun: the backpack can be personalized, making it truly your little one’s own.
fields.after: This backpack is perfect for your little one! Soft colors and playful flowers give the bag a cheerful, dreamy look, perfect for little adventurers discovering the world step by step. The backpack is water-repellent and practically organized with smart storage compartments, including a separate pocket for a cup. Thanks to the adjustable mesh shoulder straps and the handy chest buckle, the bag always stays comfortable and securely in place.

changed.name: Backpack - Teddy Bear

fields.label: Περιγραφή
fields.before: This backpack is perfect for everyday use! Whether going to daycare, school, or just out and about, this bag is light and easy to carry. The shoulder straps are soft and adjustable, ensuring comfortable wear. With the chest buckle, it stays securely in place even when your little one is very active. The water-resistant material can handle a light shower and dries quickly. Inside, there’s a separate pocket for a cup, plus extra compartments to keep small items from moving around. And perhaps the best part: the backpack can be personalized, so your child can easily recognize their own bag at the coat rack.
